notes.title: March to Glory has been updated to versio 1.5
notes.content:
Hi all,

[b]March to Glory[/b] has been updated to version [b]1.5.0![/b] 

[b]Features[/b]:
Custom map - Added the ability to place both armies on the battlefield (player & AI).
HotSeat - Two players can now customize and play any battle on the same device.
Cancel multiplayer challenge. Any game can be cancelled if no other player has joined.


[b]Bugfix[/b]:
- Game freeze in multiplayer replay.
- The game is lost if the number of turns has expired.
- "Play" button not working (more testing)
- Borodino map A.I freeze.

notes.title: [i]March to Glory[/i] has been updated to [b]version 1.4!
notes.content:
Hi all,

[i]March to Glory[/i] has been updated to [b]version 1.4![/b] 

[b]Change log:[/b]
-Localisation
Skirmish mode Single & Multiplayer: the players get to choose if they want to place the units manually on the map, default is ON
-Acquired Unity licence & removed the "Unity splash screen logo"
-Removed Line vs column shooting bonus
-Fixed artillery reaction fire (artillery has reaction fire only if it did not moved the turn prior)
-Artillery LOS tweaked (not perfect yet)
-Cavalry charges (when the infantry forms square deals only morale damage). If the cavalry attacks infantry that cannot form square, the damage is mostly permanent (red). 
-Fixed wrong briefing dates for Austerlitz and Jena
-Increasedofight to all unit by 1
-Cavalry in woods - less damage
- Healing: The way the unit heal now is -if an enemy is adjacent, the unit will heal +1, if an enemy is not adjacent he unit heals +2(or more). If a general or the unit is garrisoned the it will recover better and fully in the case of towns.
